name: Incap Oyj
summary: Incap Oyj, together with its subsidiaries, provides electronics manufacturing services in Europe, North-America, South-America, Asia, Africa, and Australia. The company offers PCB assembly and manufacturing, box-build assembly, and prototyping and engineering services, as well as cable, wire harness, and magnetic assemblies. It also offers prototypes and pre-series; and tester development products. The company serves aerospace, automotive, consumer electronics, data storage and media, defense, environment/green energy, food and vending, industrial controls and automation, medical, oil and gas mining, power, security, scientific/ instrumentation, telecom, and transport and infrastructure sectors. Incap Oyj was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Helsinki, Finland.
